codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm yellow glow from lamps contrasts with cool blue-green traffic signals.

codebook_texts.C_global: Fresh orange slices and cauliflower garnished with herbs on a wooden surface.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Reflection of the woman's face and hand visible on a smooth, transparent surface.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Soft skin tones contrast with subtle nail polish and smooth, reflective glass surface.

codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Top-down view captures flower's symmetrical structure and radial pattern.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochrome tones highlight rough, eroded stone surfaces and smooth, misty atmospheric gradient.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: High-contrast black-and-white photograph of historic ruin in open, hazy outdoor landscape.

codebook_texts.C_global: Blue fan sits on wooden floor near window, casting soft light into dim room.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Circular fan with protective metal grille and base controls stands upright.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Blurred outdoor garden with potted plants visible through glass window pane.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Fan positioned close to window, suggesting cooling air circulation indoors.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Cool blue tones dominate fan, contrasted with dark wood grain and glass reflections.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with natural daylight filtering through window, creating soft shadows.

codebook_texts.C_global: Towering skyscraper dominates urban street corner under dramatic twilight sky with scattered clouds.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: High-rise building with rounded top and grid-like windows stands prominently against evening sky.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Streetlights, pedestrians, and storefronts with glowing signs line the sidewalk at building's base.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person walks near pole on sidewalk while building looms overhead, creating strong vertical perspective.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Cool blue-gray sky contrasts with warm amber streetlights and building’s neutral stone facade.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban street scene at dusk with overcast weather, artificial lighting, and city infrastructure visible.

codebook_texts.C_global: Silhouetted figure stands alone in dimly lit, foggy tunnel with glowing purple lights.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Dark silhouette of a person wearing coat, standing upright with hands down.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Foggy mist swirls around bright purple spotlights illuminating the tunnel walls.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person positioned centrally, facing forward, surrounded by atmospheric lighting effects.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Purple and white light contrasts with black shadows, creating hazy, smoky texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor tunnel environment with artificial lighting, fog effects, and dark ambient setting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Man flies through abstract red and gray background with motion blur and lightning bolt trail.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Man with long hair, wearing dark shirt, arms extended in mid-air flight pose.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: White lightning bolt graphic trails behind the flying man, adding dynamic motion effect.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Subject appears to be flying forward with speed, indicated by motion blur and directional streaks.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Red and gray abstract swirls with smooth gradients and soft lighting contrast.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Stylized digital background with blurred motion effects, suggesting high-speed action scene.

codebook_texts.C_global: Isolated rocky island rises sharply from deep blue ocean under clear sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Steep-sided island with grassy top and rugged cliff faces dominates the view.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Distant hazy landmass appears on horizon behind the main island.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Water ripples around base of island, suggesting calm but active sea conditions.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant green vegetation contrasts with dark layered rock and deep blue water.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor coastal scene under bright daylight with minimal cloud cover.

codebook_texts.C_global: Car speeds toward tunnel entrance, mountains loom in distance under clear blue sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Vehicle dashboard and windshield frame forward motion through mountainous terrain.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Rocky cliffside with tunnel mouth ahead, distant snow-capped peaks visible beyond road.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Road curves gently toward dark tunnel, vehicle moves rapidly past sunlit cliff face.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm golden light streaks across cliff, contrasting cool blue sky and gray rocky surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor mountain highway scene at golden hour, clear weather with dramatic natural lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: A stark, solitary door stands illuminated at night, casting shadows on a textured wall.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A tall, narrow, white door with a handle and lock, centered in the frame.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A horizontal metal railing runs along the ground, positioned beside the door.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The door is lit from above, creating a spotlight effect against the dark surroundings.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: High-contrast black and white tones with rough, speckled wall texture and smooth door surface.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor nighttime urban scene with artificial lighting and concrete pavement.

codebook_texts.C_global: Sunlight filters through tall trees, illuminating a mossy forest path winding into the distance.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A narrow dirt trail meanders through dense evergreen trees with moss-covered ground.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Bright beams of sunlight pierce the canopy, casting long shadows on the forest floor.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The path curves gently forward, flanked by tall trunks and underbrush in quiet stillness.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Deep greens, earthy browns, and dappled golden light create a rich, textured woodland palette.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor forest scene with soft, diffused sunlight filtering through a dense tree canopy.

codebook_texts.C_global: Snowflakes gently fall around red boots stepping through fresh snow, leaving footprints behind.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Red boots with glossy finish and rounded toe, partially buried in snow.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Visible paw prints in snow, suggesting animal presence nearby.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Boots are positioned mid-step, indicating movement through snowy terrain.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant red boots contrast with white snow, showing smooth and reflective surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor winter scene with falling snow, soft lighting, and snowy ground.

codebook_texts.C_global: Dark background highlights elegant, flowing smoke-like forms creating abstract visual symmetry.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Two symmetrical, curved, translucent shapes resembling smoke or liquid columns against black.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Subtle gradient lighting along the curves, emphasizing depth and form in the dark void.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Forms appear to converge and diverge, suggesting dynamic motion or fluid equilibrium.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth, gradient tones from near-white to deep charcoal, with soft luminous edges.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Minimalist studio setting with controlled lighting, emphasizing abstract composition and contrast.

codebook_texts.C_global: A person with vibrant green hair gazes softly while holding a striped scarf close to their face.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Black-and-white striped knitted scarf wrapped around the person's neck and hand.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Person holds scarf near mouth, head slightly tilted, suggesting quiet contemplation or intimacy.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant teal hair contrasts with neutral-toned scarf, textured knit pattern and soft skin tones.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with dramatic lighting, dark background, and focused illumination on the subject.

codebook_texts.C_global: A savory dish with eggs and noodles served in foil-lined bowl on table.

codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Food arranged in circular pattern with garnish and utensil nearby.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Golden-brown rice, creamy white egg slices, and glossy yellow sauce.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor dining setting with plain surface and artificial lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: A woman with paint splatters across her face and chest, standing against a plain wall.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A woman with reddish-brown hair, eyes visible, and paint covering her skin.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: A textured beige wall behind the woman, serving as the background.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Paint is splattered across her face and neck, suggesting recent artistic activity.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant splashes of red, blue, green, and yellow paint on smooth skin texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with soft, even lighting and neutral-colored background wall.

codebook_texts.C_global: Stormy sky casts dramatic light over wooden pier extending into calm water at dusk.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Weathered wooden pier with slatted roof, supported by vertical pilings in water.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark clouds with sun rays breaking through, illuminating horizon over water surface.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Pier structure extends diagonally from right, receding into distance over still water.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Deep blues and grays dominate scene, with rough wooden textures and reflective water surface.

codebook_texts.C_global: Nighttime urban scene with graffiti on concrete blocks beneath ornate metal fence.

codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Graffiti message is positioned horizontally across the base of the fence structure.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm orange-yellow lighting casts glow on rough, stained concrete and dark metal.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor nighttime urban environment with artificial lighting and pavement surroundings.

codebook_texts.C_global: Row of stone busts wearing red Santa hats in outdoor cemetery setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Weathered stone busts with closed eyes, each adorned with festive red hats.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Background shows blurred trees and grass, emphasizing foreground busts.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Busts are aligned in straight line, receding into distance with perspective.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: White stone with mossy green patches, contrasted by bright red hats with white trim.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor cemetery scene under overcast lighting with natural, muted tones.

codebook_texts.C_global: Abstract glass sculpture with spherical ends stands on pedestal against gradient background.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Central metallic pedestal supports branching glass arms ending in transparent spheres.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Soft gradient backdrop transitions from light to dark, enhancing sculpture's silhouette.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Sculpture's arms radiate outward symmetrically, creating balanced visual composition.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochromatic grayscale tones highlight reflective glass and polished metal surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Studio-style lighting setup with controlled shadows on neutral background surface.

codebook_texts.C_global: Low-angle black-and-white photo captures towering Ferris wheel against stark sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Massive Ferris wheel structure with radial spokes and enclosed passenger capsules.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Prominent diagonal support beam and intricate lattice framework extending upward.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Camera positioned beneath wheel, emphasizing its scale and upward-reaching geometry.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: High-contrast monochrome tones with smooth metallic surfaces and sharp linear textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban setting under bright, overcast sky with pure white background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Creamy dessert topped with fresh blueberries and berry sauce on a white plate.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Round, smooth, pale yellow pudding mound with glossy blueberries piled on top.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Red-purple berry sauce drizzled artistically over the dessert surface.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Blueberries rest atop and around the pudding, some slightly crushed with juice.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich dark blue berries contrast with creamy white pudding and vibrant red sauce streaks.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor, well-lit setting with a clean white plate and soft ambient lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Silhouetted musician plays electric guitar under intense yellow stage lights during live concert.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Guitarist in dynamic pose, holding instrument, standing on raised platform with head tilted.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Drum kit visible in background, partially obscured by haze and lighting effects.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Musician performs energetically, audience silhouettes visible in foreground.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Dominant yellow hue with smoky haze, creating high contrast and dramatic lighting.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor concert venue with stage lighting, smoke effects, and live performance atmosphere.

codebook_texts.C_global: Mother monkey carries her baby in a serene natural setting with soft-focus greenery behind.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Adult monkey with reddish face and grayish-brown fur sits upright, gazing sideways.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Small infant monkey clings tightly to mother's chest, eyes closed in peaceful sleep.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Mother holds baby securely against her body, suggesting nurturing and protection.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Fuzzy, textured fur contrasts with smooth, pink facial skin and muted green background.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor scene under diffused daylight, with blurred trees indicating a forest or park environment.

codebook_texts.C_global: Intense fire rages across rooftop at night, casting bright orange glow against dark sky.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Flames surge upward in jagged, dynamic shapes, consuming structure with fierce energy.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Dark silhouette of roof edge frames fire, contrasting sharply with glowing embers.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Fire spreads aggressively along angled surface, propelled by unseen wind currents.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant reds, oranges, and yellows dominate, with smoky gray wisps drifting upward.

codebook_texts.C_global: Young girl stands alone in sunlit forest clearing, surrounded by green foliage and scattered rocks.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Large smooth stones and dense leafy trees form natural backdrop behind the girl.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Girl faces sideways, hands clasped in front, positioned centrally on gravel path.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Light gray dress with black polka dots, white rubber boots, and sun-dappled gravel ground.

codebook_texts.C_global: A close-up of a slice of mushroom pizza on a paper-lined tray, ready to eat.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A thick-cut pizza slice topped with sautéed mushrooms and melted cheese.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: The white paper tray beneath the pizza slice with faint printed patterns.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The pizza slice rests diagonally on the tray, showing its layered toppings.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Golden-brown mushrooms, creamy white cheese, and red tomato sauce with speckled seasoning.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with soft lighting, likely a casual dining or takeout environment.

codebook_texts.C_global: A young child with braided hair sits patiently while an adult's hand gently holds a strand of their hair.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Adult's hand wearing an orange sleeve, holding a thin strand of hair near the child's head.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: An adult is styling the child's hair outdoors, with the child looking directly at the camera.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant orange sleeve contrasts with denim jacket, golden braids, and dark natural hair texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor setting with blurred greenery and soft natural lighting, suggesting a park or garden environment.

codebook_texts.C_global: Black and white close-up of wheat stalks intertwined with barbed wire against blurred foliage.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Wheat stalks with detailed grains and fibrous texture wrapped around barbed wire.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Barbed wire coiled tightly around the wheat, showing sharp metallic edges.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Wheat stalks are entangled with barbed wire, suggesting natural growth around man-made structure.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochromatic tones highlight rough textures of wheat and metallic sheen of wire.

codebook_texts.C_global: A muscular guitarist leaps energetically while playing electric bass on a dark stage.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A man with short blond hair, wearing a white tank top and black pants, mid-air playing guitar.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Large black speaker cabinets and stage lights illuminate the performance area behind him.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The musician is jumping and strumming simultaneously, holding the instrument with both hands.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Glossy brown guitar finish, shiny black boots, and dark stage backdrop with spotlight highlights.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor concert venue with dim ambient lighting and focused stage illumination.

codebook_texts.C_global: Lily pads float serenely on dark water, reflecting cloudy sky above.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Round, spotted lily pads with purple veins rest atop calm pond surface.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant green with purple mottling, smooth waxy surfaces on each leaf.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor pond scene under overcast sky, with muted lighting and still water.

codebook_texts.C_global: Six orange plastic deer figurines arranged on a white plate with green rim.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant orange plastic with white speckles, smooth surface, glossy finish.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor setting with bright, even lighting, plain white background.

codebook_texts.C_global: A single decaying leaf floats serenely on a calm, reflective water surface under bright sunlight.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: A yellowish-green leaf with brown edges and visible veins rests partially submerged in water.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: The water's surface reflects blue sky and tree silhouettes, with scattered light glints and floating debris.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: The leaf drifts gently, surrounded by ripples and reflections, indicating stillness and natural decay.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Vibrant teal and green hues contrast with golden-yellow leaf tones and rough, weathered textures.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor natural scene with clear daylight, shallow water, and reflections suggesting a pond or stream.

codebook_texts.C_global: Vibrant red tulip stands out against monochrome garden backdrop with soft-focus foliage.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich crimson hue contrasts with grayscale tones; petals show glossy wet texture.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor garden scene under natural sunlight with shallow depth of field and soft shadows.

codebook_texts.C_global: Man stands near powerful waterfall under cloudy sky with mist rising around him.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Man in yellow jacket and brown pants poses confidently beside rocky cliff edge.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Wet gray rocks contrast with bright yellow jacket and white frothy water spray.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor mountainous landscape with overcast weather and misty atmosphere near river.

codebook_texts.C_global: Classic bicycle stands isolated against plain white background, studio-lit for product photography.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Black-framed bicycle with brown leather saddle and chrome accents, positioned in profile view.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Silver fenders, thin tires, and vintage-style handlebars with bell add to retro aesthetic.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Bicycle is stationary, centered in frame, with symmetrical wheel alignment and balanced composition.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Matte black frame contrasts with glossy chrome, brown leather, and white spoked wheels.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Minimalist studio setting with bright, even lighting and pure white backdrop for clean product display.

codebook_texts.C_global: Young girl smiles softly while wearing a patterned headscarf in a dimly lit indoor setting.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Child with dark eyes and curly hair, wearing a headscarf and light-colored top.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Softly blurred background with indistinct shapes and warm lighting tones.
codebook_texts.C_activity_or_relation: Girl gazes directly at viewer, positioned centrally with shallow depth of field.
codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochrome tones with smooth skin texture, patterned fabric, and soft shadows.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor portrait shot with shallow focus, warm ambient lighting, and muted background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Dark cobblestone street reflects cloudy sky in shallow puddles after rain.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Reflections of buildings and sky appear distorted in puddles across pavement.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Damp gray stones with rough texture contrast smooth dark water surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Urban outdoor scene under overcast sky with wet pavement from recent rainfall.

codebook_texts.C_global: Rustic stone wall frames weathered wooden window with vibrant red roses climbing upward.
codebook_texts.C_primary_object: Red roses with lush green leaves grow vertically along a wooden-framed window.
codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Weathered stone wall with visible mortar lines and a rusty metal fixture on the left.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Rich red petals contrast with rough, textured stone and aged, dark wood.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban scene under natural daylight, showing aged architecture and floral growth.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Red sweater, blue denim, wooden floor, white curtains, and red stains on ground.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor scene with wooden flooring, white curtains, and bright natural lighting.

codebook_texts.C_global: Two young children sit together in a black tub, smiling in a tiled bathroom.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Warm sepia tones dominate, with rough brick textures and glossy wet surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Indoor bathroom setting with artificial lighting, showing a utilitarian and slightly worn space.

codebook_texts.C_global: Close-up of a sculpted hand reaching forward against a blurred marble background.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth, matte, beige-toned surface with subtle shadows and highlights.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Studio-style lighting on a neutral, out-of-focus background.

codebook_texts.C_global: Silhouetted figures walk through dim, tiled tunnel toward bright exit ahead.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochrome tones with smooth tiles, rough grates, and reflective surfaces.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Underground pedestrian tunnel with artificial lighting and concrete architecture.

codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor harbor scene under soft evening light with clear blue sky and still water.

codebook_texts.C_global: Urban street corner features graffiti art on concrete wall under soft lighting.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochromatic sepia tones with rough concrete texture and spray-paint smudges.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Outdoor urban alleyway scene with muted lighting and architectural structures.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Monochrome tones highlight gritty concrete, wet floor reflections, and coarse wall textures.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Smooth, creamy white powder contrasts with the natural skin tone and matte black backdrop.
codebook_texts.C_scene_type: Studio-style lighting with dramatic shadows, set against a pure black background for artistic effect.

codebook_texts.C_global: Dark storm clouds loom over rolling green hills under a gloomy sky.

codebook_texts.C_secondary_object: Rolling green hills with visible rocky ridges stretch across the foreground.

codebook_texts.C_color_texture: Contrasting black and white stripes with soft, fuzzy fur texture and dark eye.

codebook_texts.C_global: Dimly lit room features glowing computer screens and a view of Seattle's Space Needle at night.
